# cgr01: permit the existing gold recovery with a carried bag

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, bot `leader_party_tuned`.
Only candidate `bots/pi_carrier-gold-recall-01/`; write IMPLEMENTATION.md.
Start from original, not any other experimental bot. PC builds and tests.

## Researched observation and hypothesis

Leaders complete recalls with carried gems and subsequently bank: sampled
Fish/Pantheon Swirl shows Fish Vendetta recalls125 and banks30 at130; Cassi
recalls127 and banks23 at133. The contrasting Pantheon Prism cancels recall118
and dies122, transferring23gems. These observations support evaluating a full
economic route, not assuming recall is always safe or always better than bank.

Original champion64-game screen census finds344 intervals with positive carried
gems, heldgold>=300 and no spending, comprising14199actor-roundsamples across
49games/129actors.186intervals last>=30rounds. No such interval occurs on
Guardian: its earlier farming/bank trap produces too little income, so this
change must not be presented as its solution. Temporal intervals alone do not
prove no visible threat or a safe recall.

Deterministically selected longest case: Breadcrumbs/without_search/A,
champion-screen00012.zip, Vesperentity2, rounds515–737,372gold and14gems
unchanged. Exact original pre-turn516: position(17,9),760/1000HP,372gold,
14gems, no channel/restrictions, no locally visible enemies or awake damaging
camps, outside spawn. Existing health recovery is off. The source's bag==0
condition alone blocks gold recovery. Probes626/730 have visible enemies, so
do not call all223rounds eligible for recall.

Original eventually banks738, begins recall740, cancels742 when an enemy
appears, restarts743, arrives/shops748 (12items), Strength35→95, clears a gold
camp749 and collects29gold756. This establishes delayed development and the
existing cancellation/return-to-work behavior, not the safety of an earlier
counterfactual recall.18retained source variants keep the bag==0 restriction;
the limited prior-art scan is not a claim of exhaustive novelty.

Hypothesis: allowing positive-bag actors to use existing threat-gated gold
recovery can turn idle capital into stronger useful work while preserving the
bag for later delivery. Existing enemy visibility, recall interruption, health
recovery and banking code already govern the route. Main risks are delayed
winning/late banks, loss of carried gems while recalling or returning, repeated
cancellations, extra trips, and changed fuel from an added gold query on some
positive-bag observations. Measure all of them.

## Exact production change

In Bot::facts, change ONLY the gold-based part of f.recovery:

Before:
`memory.recovering || (!s.spawn && s.bag==0 && s.foes.empty() && me.gold_count()>=Config::recall_gold)`

After:
`memory.recovering || (!s.spawn && s.foes.empty() && me.gold_count()>=Config::recall_gold)`

Preserve short-circuit order of the remaining terms. No new cache, gold
threshold, item/build/draft change, extra navigation, bank-admission timer,
danger override, task lifetime, or state priority. Do not combine bge01,
spawn repositioning or unavailable-bank work. Preserve bag_since, life,
memory.altar, bank demand and accounting. Original channels, danger and
spawn-defense priorities remain ahead of recovery; original recovery remains
ahead of bank demand. Therefore this trial can also redirect a rich positive
bag late in the game: an urgency veto would be a separate policy change and
must not be silently added to this experiment. Explicit regression gates below
are intended to reject costly delivery behavior.

Only production bot.cpp should differ. Add focused tests/documentation inside
the candidate as needed. Test actual Bot::facts or public play_turn with
controlled SDK/dependencies; do not test only a copied expression or a manually
set recovery fact. A test-only access adapter is acceptable for the private
function; do not redesign the production module to expose one condition.

Required checks: positivebag/gold300/nonspawn/nofoes produces gold recovery;
gold299 refuses; any visible foe refuses gold recovery; spawn refuses; bag0
behavior unchanged; health recovery still works with enemies/lowhealth;
existing decide priorities for active tribute/teleport, spawn-defense, danger,
recall interruption, healing and banking remain intact. Bag/life/altar history
must be unchanged by computing these facts. Test the existing late/winning-bag
priority explicitly and document it rather than claiming the new recovery is
bank-urgent-safe. Keep existing meaningful native state tests and realSDK
syntax checks. No release instrumentation or claims about mock win rates.
